description: Scheduler intents: how cron, PR gates, hosted E2E, self-heal, and audit lanes compose. Behavioural names — YAML filenames differ per org (see reference org manual).

workflows.title: Scheduled SDLC lane
workflows.summary: Cron-driven intake → clarification → BA → developer with queue discipline and evidence.

workflows.title: PR gate & preview
workflows.summary: Required checks, optional preview deploy, blocking policy and markers.

workflows.title: Hosted E2E regression
workflows.summary: Playwright (or similar) against dev/stage on a schedule and on demand.

workflows.title: Pipeline self-heal
workflows.summary: Diagnostics cadence separate from SDLC picks; report before optional agent repair.

workflows.title: Parallel audit lanes
workflows.summary: Tech, QA, and security audits on separate boards — delivery throughput stays intact.
